sudo -n docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint sh tc-web-003:evidence -c 'echo user=$(id -un); echo node=$(node -v); echo top-level-modules: $(ls /app/node_modules); for p in typescript vitest playwright @playwright prettier tailwindcss postcss autoprefixer esbuild vite eslint; do if [ -e /app/node_modules/$p ]; then echo PRESENT $p; exit 1; else echo absent $p; fi; done; for b in npm npx corepack; do if command -v $b; then echo PRESENT $b; exit 1; else echo absent $b; fi; done; test ! -e /app/node_modules/next/dist/bin/next && echo absent next-cli; du -sh /app'

sudo -n docker rm -f tc-web-003-smoke >/dev/null 2>&1; sudo -n docker run -d --name tc-web-003-smoke --network none tc-web-003:evidence >/dev/null && sleep 6 && sudo -n docker exec tc-web-003-smoke node -e "const h=require('http');h.get('http://127.0.0.1:3000/login',r=>{console.log('GET /login',r.statusCode);h.get('http://127.0.0.1:3000/dashboard',s=>{console.log('GET /dashboard',s.statusCode,s.headers.location);process.exit(r.statusCode===200&&s.statusCode===307?0:1)})})"; rc=$?; sudo -n docker logs tc-web-003-smoke; sudo -n docker rm -f tc-web-003-smoke >/dev/null; exit $rc
